notes.title: Game patches/ corruption of old save data
notes.content:
[b]First off thank you everyone for playing this weird little game and being patient with me as I try to remedy some of it's jank post launch![/b]

Today I put out just a minor update that fixes a few spelling errors, some clipping models, and fixed a lot of the Japanese localization.

However I forgot that updating map files result in corrupting saves that had older versions of that map's data in them. To remedy this without sacrificing new save data I have added a public opt in beta named "version1.0"

This is build just before these map changes and should allow you to use your old save data just fine.

Going forward I will only put out patches when they contain a more significant amount of fixes, and will add betas such as "version1.0" as needed.

notes.title: One of my favorite indie RPGs is getting a follow-up made with FromSoftware's 25-year-old Super Mario Maker for first person dungeon crawlers
notes.content: The excellent 2023 first person RPG Lunacid is getting the last (but coolest) follow-up I ever would have expected. Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a spinoff made with Sword of Moonlight, an incredible little game-making toolkit released by FromSoftware all the way back in 2000, and Tears of the Moon is releasing next month... Read more.
